findings.quote: A **mass extinction** is a short span of time in which a large share of living species die out. Mass extinctions mark the end of the Paleozoic and of the Mesozoic.
findings.problem: This paragraph in Geologic Time has four sentences, over the one-to-three limit. Several other new paragraphs also have four: the cross-cutting paragraph ("Something must exist before it can be cut."), the index-fossil paragraph ("An **index fossil** helps with this."), the half-life paragraph ("Each half-life halves what remains:"), and the Speed Tricks paragraphs on what the clue compares, the parent to daughter ratio and placing life on the time scale. New text must fix every Minor.
